subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should `models.providers.*.models[].input` be a text/image-only runtime input contract, broader provider-reported metadata that may include audio/video, or broader metadata with explicit clamping/override rules for unsupported runtime paths?
rationale: Current main preserves audio/video in configured model metadata while registry validation, docs, and image-routing behavior remain narrower, so an implementation would change public config and provider-routing semantics.

options.title: Broader metadata plus guardrails
options.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata, but add capability-aware validation, clear unsupported-runtime diagnostics, and an explicit override/clamping contract where needed.

options.title: Text/image-only contract
options.body: Reject audio/video in configured model inputs and add migration/docs/tests for existing configs and generated catalogs that currently carry those values.

options.title: Defer to generated-catalog widening first
options.body: Land the generated-catalog audio/video acceptance path first, then revisit user-declared unsupported-capability validation as a separate product decision.

recommendation.title: Broader metadata plus guardrails
recommendation.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata, but add capability-aware validation, clear unsupported-runtime diagnostics, and an explicit override/clamping contract where needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans config compatibility, provider/catalog metadata, and runtime routing, and history shows adjacent ownership across those surfaces.
